description: Land Title Settlement Department - Madugama, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720004 and other Title Settlement
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and owner details) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 classification.
